findings.defect: Vitest import failures and hook dispatcher crash in OnboardingWizardModal during SSR/Node test runs
findings.resolution: Converted tests to node:test + node:assert/strict with React 19 safe internals detection for initialShowRapidWizard

findings.defect: Register.tsx omitted practiceType and withDemoData in POST body to /api/auth/register
findings.resolution: Included practiceType: scale and withDemoData: seedDemoData in POST body, synchronized onboardingStore, and pre-seeded offline fallback dashboard

findings.defect: onboardingStore defaulted to 2 chairs and 09:00-20:00 despite solo_doctor being default profile mode
findings.resolution: Configured DEFAULT_SOLO_CHAIRS (1 chair: 'Кресло 1 (Терапия)') and DEFAULT_SOLO_SCHEDULE (09:00-18:00) as initial state and in resetWizard; enhanced setOperationalMode to adapt both chairs and schedule

findings.defect: createOfflineFallbackDashboard defaulted to 2 chairs and empty arrays (patients: [], appointments: []), causing blank screen dead-end on offline/local first-run
findings.resolution: Updated createOfflineFallbackDashboard to generate 1 chair for solo doctor and seed 4 starter demo patients and appointments for today when withDemoData !== false or in demo/offline mode

findings.defect: Step3StarterPricelist contained prohibited label 'Снимок / КЛКТ' for intraoral radiovisiography RVG
findings.resolution: Renamed category label from 'Снимок / КЛКТ' to 'Прицельный снимок / РВГ' to strictly honor the prohibition against CBCT/tomography triggers
